EC1: Established pre-existing diabetes (including unrecognised diabetes defined as a fasting plasma glucose [OR] = 7.0mmol/L and/ or HbA1c = 48mmol/mol); Contraindications [AND] to metformin therapy (creatinine [OR] = 130µmol/L/ alanine transaminase [OR] = 2.0 x upper limit normal/ previous intolerance [AND] to metformin)
EC2: Planned continued antenatal care/ delivery at centre not included in trial
EC3: Planned fast for cultural/ religious reasons e.g. Ramadan
